purpose: Advisory review at final submission or a declared intermediate checkpoint, without mandatory veto or automatic repair.

arms.R0: Identical draft and selected evidence; no checker report

runtime_inputs: selected source-field records with exact locators
shared_admission: Both engines share shape/schema validation and applicability gates; their existence is not evidence of independent semantic extraction.

statuses.pass: Declared check agrees with selected evidence; not truth or completeness
statuses.flag: Bound value or unit differs from selected field under exact policy
statuses.unknown: Required source, field, value or unit unavailable

no_coercion: Integers, floating-point values, strings and booleans remain distinct JSON lexical representations. Unit conversion and synonyms are not implemented.
denominators: all submitted drafts including parse failures
all declared claims including unprojectable claims
all requested checks including unknown and not-applicable
all attempted revisions including truncations and regressions
planned_measures: error detection among adjudicated in-scope errors
unnecessary flags among adjudicated correct in-scope claims
revision fixes and newly introduced errors
controls_needed_before_paid_study: expert or disclosed coordinator projection audit
same-budget self-review control to isolate second-pass effects
fresh independent review and bounded budget
scope: Current real questions and outputs are consumed development. Synthetic mutations are software diagnostics, not new real-world benchmark cases. No physical action recommendations.
